title: Detect cells (EXTRACT)
description: Runs EXTRACT (extractor, with get_defaults) on the stack, when it is on the MATLAB path, and saves its cells as ROIs (the connected pixels around each cell's peak whose spatial weight is above threshold times the peak's) and its traces as signals. Its options are passed to EXTRACT under EXTRACT's names (given in each option's description), with EXTRACT's defaults, except the partitions: one, as dev's, unless either is 0.

stack.title: Stack
stack.description: Variable that holds the image stack (height x width x frames).

rois.title: ROIs
rois.description: Variable the cells are saved to as ROIs.

output.title: Signals
output.description: Variable the result is saved to.

minSnr.title: Smallest trace SNR
minSnr.description: EXTRACT's thresholds.T_min_snr: cells with weaker traces are left out

threshold.title: Mask threshold
threshold.description: Share of a cell's largest spatial weight a pixel needs to be part of its ROI

traceOutputOption.title: Traces
traceOutputOption.description: EXTRACT's trace_output_option: how the final traces are estimated (nonneg: non-negative; no_constraint: raw)

cellfindMinSnr.title: Smallest SNR to find a cell
cellfindMinSnr.description: EXTRACT's cellfind_min_snr: the peak SNR an object needs to be taken as a cell while cells are found

maxIterations.title: Iterations
maxIterations.description: EXTRACT's max_iter: iterations of the alternating estimation of cells and traces

spatialHighpassCutoff.title: Spatial highpass cutoff
spatialHighpassCutoff.description: EXTRACT's spatial_highpass_cutoff, relative to the cell radius: higher filters the movie less

temporalDenoising.title: Temporal denoising
temporalDenoising.description: EXTRACT's temporal_denoising: wavelet denoising of each pixel's trace before cells are found (slow)

dendriteAware.title: Keep dendrites
dendriteAware.description: EXTRACT's dendrite_aware: elongated components are not left out

partitionsX.title: Partitions across
partitionsX.description: EXTRACT's num_partitions_x: the movie is cut into this many parts across, each run on its own. 0 here or in partitionsY lets EXTRACT choose both

channel.title: Channel
channel.description: Of a stack with channels (height x width x channels x frames): the one to use, from 1

plane.title: Plane
plane.description: Of a stack with planes (height x width x channels x planes x frames): the one to use, from 1
